production_source_comparison.interpretation: All executable/config/build sources match the cloud artifact; only listed prior user extensions differ. Later documentation does not change these runtime sources.

visual_review.scope: Manually viewed the Debian 12 and EL7 HWP request fixture screenshots at original resolution. All 36 HWP rows are visible, including the 25 added rows; labels, units, raw values, read-only states, PECI max/EPP editing restrictions, CPU selection, and the wrapped description were checked. This review covers these two images only, not all 847 retained screenshots.

limits: New HWP request fields are read-only and independently CPUID-gated. Stored hints and history do not measure delivered performance.
EL7 target is Oracle Linux 7.9 x86_64; other RHEL/CentOS 7 configurations have not been certified.
Request sources are separate samples, not an atomic effective request. No PECI/package/polarity/notification writes or physical hardware acceptance.
Windows/macOS test the portable core, not a complete hardware backend.
ICCmax/VR, Vmax/extended TVB, remaining AMD and motherboard controls, and Secure Boot acceptance remain incomplete.

local_user_port_tests.context: Windows host lacks native Linux/C++ toolchain; all applicable cloud distro checks ran without those skips. User extensions retained.
